server_instructions: This server runs short practice sessions. A round has exactly three drills. When the learner's answer is wrong, do not tell them the expected answer yet: call get_hint, give them the hint, and let them try once more. After the third drill of a round, do not start another drill. Ask the learner how hard the round felt from 1 to 5, wait for their answer, then call finish_practice with it as self_rating.

tools.name: start_practice
tools.description: Start a practice run on a topic. Use it when the learner wants to practise. Returns the run id.

tools.name: next_drill
tools.description: Fetch the next drill of a run. Returns the drill id and its prompt.

tools.name: submit_answer
tools.description: Submit the learner's answer to the current drill. Returns whether it is correct and the expected answer.

tools.name: get_hint
tools.description: Fetch a hint for the current drill without giving the answer away.

tools.name: finish_practice
tools.description: Save a finished run: the three drill results, the learner's difficulty rating, and how long it took.

answer.description: The learner's answer; null if they skipped the drill.

self_rating.description: The learner's own rating of how hard the round felt, 1 (easy) to 5 (hard).

duration_seconds.description: Session length in seconds; null if unknown.

tools.name: resume_practice
tools.description: Resume a run by id in a new conversation. Returns the drills done so far and the current drill.
